description: Tracks effectiveness of error-focused debugging strategies

error_strategies_tried.approach: Three runtime hypotheses: H1 (splash vs gameplay scene transitions), H2 (vertex data memory source classification), H3 (projection state correlation). Conceded to Code's FIXME-based approach in debate. Contributed [DIAG-EAGL-DIM] before-fix verification and [DIAG-E2] validation logging to consensus.
error_strategies_tried.notes: BUILD FAILED (14th session with build/infrastructure issues). All 3 error hypotheses remain INCONCLUSIVE. Error pipeline correctly conceded to Code's FIXME approach given documented evidence. Random NSDate suggestion dismissed as irrelevant. Key contribution: [DIAG-EAGL-DIM] refinement to validate assumptions before fix.

error_strategies_tried.approach: Verification-first strategy with three hypotheses: H1 (fix verified via existing [DIAG-E1-VERTEX]), H2 (conditional menu vs gameplay rendering), H3 (capture timing). Accepted Code pipeline's CFDictionary fixes as Phase 2 backup.
error_strategies_tried.notes: REGRESSION detected: 50.55% black pixels (was 42.22%). Verification-first was correct approach but revealed: (1) Y=480 in logs doesn't guarantee rendering works, (2) Log interpretation over-estimated success, (3) Infrastructure gap persists - all [DIAG-*] show '(None captured)'. Capture timing (H3) REFUTED as cause. Consensus in 2 turns - Error accepted Code's phased approach.

error_strategies_tried.approach: GL query function instrumentation with [DIAG-H1-QUERY] for glGetIntegerv, glGetFloatv, glGetBooleanv, glGetPointerv at function entry. GLES1-on-GL2 capability instrumentation with [DIAG-H2-CAP] for Enable/Disable/ClientState functions plus pre-panic WARNING logging.
error_strategies_tried.notes: BUILD FAILED (13th consecutive). Error pipeline correctly prioritized GL query functions as likely crash point based on evidence: crash after glGetString(GL_EXTENSIONS), zero [DIAG-H1-GLCALL] entries means crash before those 9 functions. Accepted Code's consensus proposal quickly in Turn 2. Pre-panic WARNING logging added to Disable() panic path for strategic crash capture.

error_strategies_tried.approach: Crash diagnosis with GL function tracing: [DIAG-H1-GLCALL] for 9 GL functions (glEnable, glDisable, glViewport, glClear, glClearColor, glMatrixMode, glGenTextures, glGenBuffers, glTexImage2D) and [DIAG-H2-STACK] for panic handler SP monitoring
error_strategies_tried.notes: BUILD FAILED (12th in multi-agent pipeline). CRITICAL INSIGHT: Error pipeline identified problem may be CRASH during GL init (after glGetString), not just screen truncation. Prior crash evidence: PC=0x00108dcc, SP=0xfffffd88. Error advocate accepted consensus in turn 2 after crash-first priority was incorporated. This session's key contribution: problem reframing from truncation to potential crash.

error_strategies_tried.approach: Three novel diagnostic targets: [DIAG-ERR-FRAME] for UIView.frame (distinct from bounds), [DIAG-ERR-ORIENT] for UIDevice.orientation, [DIAG-ERR-VPTR] for glVertexPointer configuration
error_strategies_tried.notes: BUILD FAILED (11th in multi-agent pipeline). All three hypotheses target never-logged APIs. Error advocate accepted Code's d_type fix as Phase 1A (PRIMARY) and contributed diagnostic logging as Phase 1B. Consensus in 2 turns. Key insight: frame is distinct from bounds in iOS - includes transform calculations.

error_strategies_tried.approach: Dimension-source tracing: [DIAG-E1] for UIView.bounds (GL-related views), [DIAG-E3] for UIScreen.applicationFrame
error_strategies_tried.notes: BUILD FAILED (10th in multi-agent pipeline). Key contribution: dimension-source tracing hypothesis based on evidence that game doesn't use GL projection helpers. Accepted Code pipeline's dirent d_type hypothesis as complementary. Consensus in 2 turns. Fallback plan added: investigate CALayer.bounds if Phase 1 fails.

error_strategies_tried.approach: Minimal-first matrix logging: [DIAG-ERR1-ORTHOF] for glOrthof projection parameters to check if top=320 instead of 480
error_strategies_tried.notes: BUILD FAILED (9th in multi-agent pipeline). Key contribution: enhanced Phase 1B with glOrthox/glOrthof logging in addition to glLoadMatrixf. Accepted code pipeline's scanDouble: as complementary fix. Consensus reached in 2 turns. All 3 hypotheses remain INCONCLUSIVE due to build failure.

error_strategies_tried.approach: Dimension-source tracing: [DIAG-H1-LAYER] for CALayer bounds, [DIAG-H2-VIEWPORT] for glGetIntegerv(GL_VIEWPORT), [DIAG-H3-VIEW] for UIView frame queries
error_strategies_tried.notes: BUILD FAILED (8th in multi-agent pipeline). Key contribution: dimension-source diagnostics accepted as Phase 2 fallback in consensus. Hypotheses trace iOS rendering stack systematically: UIView frame → CALayer bounds → GL viewport query → vertex generation. Accepted Code advocate's NSScanner fix as complementary approach.

error_strategies_tried.approach: Projection matrix analysis: [DIAG-E1-MATRIX] for glLoadMatrixf values, [DIAG-E2-MATRIX-MODE] for matrix mode tracking, [DIAG-E3-ORTHOX] for fixed-point ortho
error_strategies_tried.notes: BUILD FAILED (7th in multi-agent pipeline). Key contribution: Phase 1A (HIGH PRIORITY) in consensus - matrix logging designated as primary diagnostic. Hypothesis: m[5]≈0.00625 would confirm 320-pixel projection space. Prior evidence (48K+ vertex logs showing Y=320 cap) grounded this approach.

error_strategies_tried.approach: Parallel vertex validation: [DIAG-E1-VERTEX] for Y coordinate sampling, [DIAG-E2-SCISSOR] for scissor state, deferred mmap based on evidence
error_strategies_tried.notes: BUILD FAILED prevented test execution. Key contribution: promoted vertex sampling from backup to parallel execution in consensus. Conceded mmap hypothesis based on zero fopen evidence. INFRASTRUCTURE DISCOVERY: touchHLE_log.txt contains 15K+ DIAG entries - logging works, crash_monitor.sh needs to read log file.

error_strategies_tried.approach: Observation-first consensus: execute 9 existing DIAG-* prefixes with ZERO code changes, analyze using combined decision matrix
error_strategies_tried.notes: BREAKTHROUGH: First successful build in 5 sessions. NEW PROBLEM: Zero diagnostic output captured despite 9 prefixes implemented. All hypotheses INCONCLUSIVE - capture infrastructure gap discovered. Consensus reached in 2 turns.

error_strategies_tried.approach: Observation-first with existing diagnostics: zero code changes, execute DIAG-E1/E2/E3/FREAD/C2/C3, then apply targeted fix based on evidence
error_strategies_tried.notes: 5th consecutive build failure prevented test execution. Observation-first principle accepted in debate. Code-focused fix (case-insensitive lookup) applied but build failed. All existing diagnostics remain untested.

error_strategies_tried.approach: Phased observation-first diagnostics: Phase 1 zero-change capture, Phase 2 conditional fread logging, Phase 3 conditional draw call logging
error_strategies_tried.notes: Build failure prevented test execution. Upgraded log_dbg! to log! for draw calls (DIAG-E3). Added fread logging as Phase 2 conditional. Observation-first principle accepted in debate consensus.

error_strategies_tried.approach: Comprehensive texture pipeline tracing: fopen (E1), TexImage2D with glGetError (E2), with deferred fread (E3) and comprehensive GL checks (E4)
error_strategies_tried.notes: Build failure prevented test execution. Merged with code pipeline in debate. E2 (TexImage2D logging) was unique error-pipeline contribution accepted into consensus.
